## 🐛 Type of Issue
- [ ] Mathematical / Scientific Error in Derivation
- [ ] Typo or Formatting Flaw (LaTeX rendering, Markdown)

## 📍 Location
Specify the file path and line number/section (e.g., `physics/kinematics/projectile_motion.md`).

## ❌ Current Behavior / Error
Describe what is wrong or paste the current text/code.

## ✅ Expected / Correct Behavior
Provide the correct derivation, formula fix, or expected script output.

## 🛠️ Additional Context
Attach screenshots or code logs if applicable.
